options.name: config_file
options.description: Path to the kopia configuration file describing the connection. Defaults to kopia's own configuration path when unset.

options.name: enable_full
options.description: Enable or disable periodic full maintenance.

options.name: enable_quick
options.description: Enable or disable periodic quick maintenance.

options.name: extend_object_locks
options.description: Extend the retention period of locked objects as needed.

options.name: full_interval
options.description: Interval between full maintenance runs, in seconds.

options.name: max_retained_log_age
options.description: Maximum age of retained log sessions, in seconds.

options.name: max_retained_log_count
options.description: Maximum number of log sessions to retain.

options.name: max_retained_log_size_mb
options.description: Maximum total size of retained log sessions, in megabytes.

options.name: owner
options.description: Maintenance owner as C(user@hostname). kopia resolves the special value V(me) to the current user and host at set time, so V(me) always reports a change, prefer the explicit form.

options.name: quick_interval
options.description: Interval between quick maintenance runs, in seconds.
